description_short.value: Ghanaian marketer of petroleum and other energy products, with bulk import, bitumen and payments subsidiaries; about a third owned by the state.
description_short.source: Written by us from the GOIL PLC 2025 Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements (GSE PR 181/2026, report of the directors)

description_full.value: GOIL PLC markets petroleum and other energy products and services in Ghana. It wholly owns four subsidiaries: Goenergy Limited, a bulk importer, storer, distributor and trader of petroleum products; GOIL Upstream Limited, which works in oil and gas operations and offers consultancy across West Africa; Gobitumen Limited, which produces and sells bitumen products; and Go Financial Services Limited, licensed for electronic payments and money transfers. It also holds 60% of African Bitumen Terminal Limited, a bitumen venture with Societe Multinationale De Bitumes of Cote d'Ivoire that it accounts for as a joint venture rather than a subsidiary. The Government of Ghana owns 34.23% of the company and private investors the rest. GOIL has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 16 November 2007, and its head office is in Adabraka, Accra. Its business runs on thin margins: in 2025 net revenue of GHS 17.2 billion produced a profit after tax of GHS 91 million, and it has paid a small final dividend every year.
